description: Session-start convenience check (git conventions, Hub link state, stale AGENTS.md block) and effort capture (HH-133): timestamps of prompts, stops, tool steps and session end on the claimed story, buffered locally as human/AI segments — timestamps, actor and category only. Never a network call, never blocks the session. HH-199: before a work_progress / work_verify / work_complete call for the claimed story that leaves out the measured effort, it refuses that call once with the exact fields to add (never approving or widening a permission), and after a work_complete it says so when measured effort was still left behind. Story worktrees (HH-90): a work_claim / work_progress / work_verify call renews the recorded lease of its story's worktree.
